priceSnapshot.note: The 02:07 midnight report printed 78,045.3 and left an ADD gate at a settled 1H close above 78,300.0. That gate FIRED. The 09:00Z hour closed 78,518.3 and the 10:00Z hour closed 78,705.9 - two consecutive settled closes above the trigger - and price extended to 78,800.0 before the 11:00Z bar gave the whole move back, opening 78,706.0 and closing 78,315.5 on a 78,297.7 low. Spot is 78,316.0 now, 270.7 points and 0.35 percent above the midnight read but sitting exactly where the gate was, which means the morning session inherits a breakout that triggered and then failed to hold. The 24h open is 78,174.6, the 24h high 79,401.4 and the 24h low 77,000.0. sessionRange below covers 02:00 COT (07:00Z) forward, the window this report is responsible for.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE below 77,950.0 and no reclaim on the next bar. RAISED from the 77,400.0 that stood unchanged through four consecutive reports, and the reason is structural rather than nervous: the tape has built a higher low. The 04:45Z flush bottomed at 77,000.0, the reaction low since 07:00Z is 77,973.4, and every hourly bar of the European morning has held above 77,900. A close back under 77,950.0 does not just dent the morning - it erases the higher low and puts 77,550.0 and then the old 77,400.0 gate back in play in one motion. Note the honest cost of moving this gate up: it is now only 366 points beneath spot, roughly 0.82 hourly ATRs, which is inside the whipsaw band this log has been documenting all week. The one-bar reclaim clause is there to absorb exactly that.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above 78,800.0. RAISED from 78,300.0, which has been consumed - it fired at 09:00Z, was confirmed at 10:00Z, and price still could not hold it. A gate that triggered and produced a 202-point drawdown is spent information. 78,800.0 is the session high, it is where the 09:00Z bar topped out, and it sits just above the 78,500.0 bucket where 1,648,158 USD of short liquidations burned this morning. Clearing it on a close means the squeeze found real demand rather than just stopped-out shorts, and it opens 79,401.4.

decisionBox.changed: BOTH GATES MOVE, because both were resolved overnight. The ADD at 78,300.0 fired and failed; it goes to 78,800.0. The REDUCE at 77,400.0 was never approached - the session low is 573.4 points above it - and it goes up to 77,950.0 to sit under the new higher low. The stance changes from HOLD to ADD, and that is the substantive call of this report. Four things support it. FIRST, the liquidation tape since the midnight file is 42.7 to one short-side: 2,247,703 USD of forced short covering against 52,684 USD of long, with 1,648,158 of that in the single 78,500.0 bucket. That is a genuine squeeze, not a drift. SECOND, and this is the part that matters, the squeeze did NOT bring retail longs with it. The OKX long/short account ratio has fallen through the rally - 1.15 at midnight, 1.14 at 09:00Z, 1.13 at 10:00Z, 1.12 at 11:00Z - while open interest rose only 0.82 percent to 2,156,530,567.77 USD. Funding is 0.0000764743220984 per 8h, a mild 0.00765 percent, and the perpetual premium is still NEGATIVE at -0.0004175482638549 after a 1,316-point advance off the 77,000 low. A rally that shorts paid for, that longs have not crowded into, and that still trades under index is the structurally healthy kind. THIRD, price is coiled on a three-EMA shelf: the 1H EMA50 at 78,295.5, the 1H EMA100 at 78,317.5 and the 4H EMA20 at 78,287.2, all inside 30 points of spot at 78,316.0. That shelf was resistance yesterday and is being tested as support today. FOURTH, the daily frame never broke - RSI 70.32, MACD histogram positive at +296.04, price above all four daily EMAs. Against all of that: Brent is 91.23, up 3.55 percent and ACCELERATING from the 90.52 and 2.75 percent the midnight file recorded, as the Hormuz mining threat escalates. WTI is 86.62, up 3.86 percent. That is a live inflation shock into a market that has already repriced September, with US10Y at 4.72. It is why this is range-with-a-tilt and an ADD sized as a small tranche rather than a bullish call and a full deployment. The resting stop stays RECOMMENDED at 76,850.0, just beneath the 76,888.0 invalidation, because the next report is midday at 12:40 COT and the window it spans includes the US cash open.

liquidation.note: 2,461,657 USD of forced LONG selling in the trailing 24h aggregate, most of it inside the 04:45Z flush to 77,000.0. Realized flow, so the fuel here has already burned - it reads as a memory of where longs were cleared, not as resting orders.

2,456,465 USD of long liquidations over 24h and the densest forced-selling reference beneath spot once the 78,000-handle short covering is excluded. This is the downside magnet: a retest that fails here is where the bearish case restarts, and it sits 199.4 points under the new 77,950.0 reduce gate.

3,535,435 USD over 24h, the largest single bucket on the board, of which 304,235 USD was short covering inside this morning's window. Price is 66 points above it and this is the level the 11:00Z rejection came back to.

1,648,158 USD of SHORT liquidations in the 07:07Z-to-11:54Z window - 73 percent of all forced flow this morning and the ignition point of the squeeze. Nearest upside magnet, with the realized-versus-resting caveat: the shorts that stopped out here are gone, so this now reads as supply-by-memory that has to be cleared a second time.
347,995 USD of short liquidations in the same window, the upper lip of the squeeze band and 50 points under the 78,800.0 session high that now defines the add gate.

liquidityMagnet.note: Balanced rather than up, and the reasoning is worth stating. By raw USD the heaviest cluster is above, at 78,500.0, but every dollar of it is REALIZED short covering that has already been consumed - it is drag on the next attempt, not a target pulling price higher. Beneath, the 77,750.0 and 77,500.0 long-liquidation bands are equally spent. With both sides of the ladder burned inside the last 24 hours, there is no live magnet in either direction and price is free to trade the 77,950-to-78,800 box on its own merits until new leverage is added.

scalpContext.intradayBias: Range with an upward tilt, and the box is well defined for once: 77,950.0 at the bottom, where the new reduce gate sits under the higher low, and 78,800.0 at the top, where the morning squeeze died. Spot at 78,316.0 is 46 percent through that box, close enough to the middle that neither edge pays. The higher-probability trade is buying a controlled retest of 78,050-77,975 with the 1H EMA20 at 78,263.5 as the first reclaim target, not chasing here. Do not short into 78,500: 1,648,158 USD of shorts were just cremated there and the level will be defended by anyone who covered.

calibration.rollingRecord: Twenty-three sessions logged. The 0.4-to-0.6 ATR band tally now reads: four clean confirmations, two whipsaws, one gate that whipsawed then confirmed on the second trigger, one that triggered twice and was voided both times, one report whose ADD and REDUCE both fired nine hours apart, one window in which BOTH gates were pierced intraday and NEITHER confirmed on a close, and now - this run - one ADD gate that confirmed properly on two consecutive settled closes and still lost money.
calibration.note: THE RESULT WORTH KEEPING. The midnight file's ADD gate at a settled 1H close above 78,300.0 fired cleanly: 78,518.3 at 09:00Z, then 78,705.9 at 10:00Z, two consecutive confirmations with no ambiguity. Price ran to 78,800.0, a further 94 points, and then the 11:00Z bar erased the whole thing, closing 78,315.5. Anyone who acted on the trigger at the 09:00Z close is 202.3 points underwater right now, so actingHelped is FALSE. This is a more useful failure than a whipsaw, because the confirmation machinery worked exactly as designed and the trade still lost - the lesson is not about the rule, it is about position sizing into a 78,500.0 short-liquidation shelf that had just been consumed. priorReduceFired is FALSE and unambiguous: the 77,400.0 gate was never approached, the session low being 77,973.4, a full 573.4 points above it. Two housekeeping backfills were applied to calibration.json with this run: the 2026-08-30 endday row gets price_next_report 78,045.3, and the 2026-08-31 midnight row gets price_next_report 78,316.0 with add_fired corrected from its placeholder false to TRUE and acting_helped set to false. Rows were modified in place, never rewritten; all 137 prior rows are intact and one new row was appended.
